source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Offering fairly little meaningful clinical benefit to smaller facilities that lack an on-site stroke specialist available around the clock every day","B":"Being useful mainly within large urban academic medical centers rather than in smaller rural facilities like this particular community hospital","C":"Taking the place of any in-person care the client might otherwise still need throughout the remainder of their hospital stay and recovery","D":"Remote neurologist evaluation via video and data sharing, supporting timely stroke assessment and treatment decisions in facilities without on-site stroke specialists"}}
source_row.rationale: Telestroke technology allows remote neurologist evaluation via video and data sharing, supporting timely stroke assessment and treatment decisions in facilities without on-site stroke specialists, particularly valuable for rural or underserved areas.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose and Value of Telestroke Technology
